env.description: Applied over smolmux's own environment with its private variables removed

cols.description: The PTY size until a Pane sizes it; default 80

labels.description: Caller labels kept on the Companion session; owner, instance, and session are smolmux's

scrollback.description: Lines of history above the screen; at most 10000, default none

key.description: One named key (enter, escape, tab, backspace, delete, insert, home, end, pageup, pagedown, up, down, left, right, space, f1-f24) or a single character

text.description: Delivered as one key press per character, the way typing looks to a program

paste.description: Delivered whole, bracketed when the Session turned bracketed paste on, so a program can tell it from typing

button.description: default left; ignored by move and scroll

x.description: Cell from the Session's own left edge, not the stage's

y.description: Cell from the Session's own top edge

scroll.description: Required by scroll, and meaningless to every other action

focus.description: Omitted keeps the focus if that Session is still shown

revision.description: The revision this tree was built from. The apply is refused as a conflict when the Layout has moved since, so a human's divider drag is never silently clobbered by a stale read-modify-write.

text.description: What the clipboard should hold; as much as a paste

size.description: Fixed columns in a row, rows in a column; omitted takes the remainder

min.description: The smallest length along this node's parent's axis; default 1

pid.description: The child's pid; null while unknown

shown.description: Whether a Pane of the current Layout shows it
